findings.title: Malformed IP/CIDR Definition
findings.description: Invalid source address '192.0.2.0/35': '192.0.2.0/35' does not appear to be an IPv4 or IPv6 network
findings.remediation: Correct invalid subnet mask or IP string to RFC-compliant IPv4 format.

findings.title: Missing Business Justification / Description
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-113' has no business justification or owner documentation.
findings.remediation: Add a descriptive explanation, change ticket ID, and application owner before migration.

findings.title: Unnamed Firewall Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-113' has no descriptive name identifier.
findings.remediation: Assign a standard naming convention (e.g., APP_DB_TIER_INGRESS).

findings.title: Exact Duplicate Access Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-104' is an exact duplicate of preceding rule 'RULE-103'.
findings.remediation: Decommission and remove rule 'RULE-104' to reduce rule base complexity.

findings.title: Fully Shadowed Redundant Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-104' is completely shadowed by earlier rule 'RULE-103' with identical action (permit). Traffic will never hit this rule.
findings.remediation: Consolidate or delete rule 'RULE-104'.

findings.title: Fully Shadowed Redundant Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-105' is completely shadowed by earlier rule 'RULE-103' with identical action (permit). Traffic will never hit this rule.
findings.remediation: Consolidate or delete rule 'RULE-105'.

findings.title: Action Conflict Shadowed Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-106' (deny) is masked by earlier rule 'RULE-103' (permit). The intended policy of 'RULE-106' will be silently overridden.
findings.remediation: Reorder rules: place specific rule 'RULE-106' above generic rule 'RULE-103'.

findings.title: Fully Shadowed Redundant Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-114' is completely shadowed by earlier rule 'RULE-103' with identical action (permit). Traffic will never hit this rule.
findings.remediation: Consolidate or delete rule 'RULE-114'.

findings.title: Unrestricted Permit Any-Any Rule
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-107' allows unrestricted IP traffic from ANY source to ANY destination across all ports.
findings.remediation: Replace with zero-trust microsegmentation rules specifying distinct network objects and destination ports.

findings.title: Sensitive Management Service Exposed: HTTP (Cleartext) (Port 80)
findings.description: Rule 'RULE-102' permits inbound access to sensitive service 'HTTP (Cleartext)' (port 80) from untrusted zone 'outside'.
findings.remediation: Block inbound port 80 or route through VPN with multi-factor authentication (MFA) and dedicated bastion hosts.
